description:
Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to exclude category pages during a crawl of an online bookstore. 

STEPS:
1. Open Configuration > Exclude (or Include/Exclude).
2. Add the regex pattern '.*\/category\/.*' to the Exclude list to skip category listing pages.
3. Open Configuration > Spider > Limits and set the 'Limit Crawl Total' (Max URLs) to 50.
4. Enter 'https://books.toscrape.com/' in the URL bar and start the crawl.
5. Wait for the crawl to finish (it should be quick due to the limit).
6. Export the 'Internal' tab results (ensure filter is set to 'HTML') as a CSV file to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- An export CSV exists in the specified folder.
- The CSV contains URLs from books.toscrape.com.
- NO URLs containing '/category/' are present in the export.
- At least 5 product URLs (containing '/catalogue/') are present.
- The total number of URLs in the export is 50 or fewer.
